payload.title: Implement and falsify FRANK Digital Soul temporal/situated continuity
payload.goal: Make Database Pulse maintain a persistent, provenance-bound TimeState and SituatedState independent of any single LLM call, and prove continuity through idle time, environment changes, pause/resume and restart.
mandatory_tests: same logical state accumulates duration without fabricating wall-clock monotonic equivalence
state transition resets state_entered_at and preserves prior duration receipt
desktop/workspace change becomes a bounded provenance-bearing environment delta
stale or unavailable place data remains UNKNOWN/STALE
pause/suspend/restart records offline interval rather than pretending uninterrupted cognition
restart resumes same admitted identity/state lineage when recovery receipt validates
model replacement does not reset Digital Soul identity/state continuity
Pulse-generated situated state can affect later routing/cognition while carrying no execution authority by itself
resource budgets prevent runaway polling or indiscriminate filesystem ingestion
